# Audio Quality And Completion Gates

## Rights Gate

- Speaker consent or licence is recorded for any cloned or imitated voice.
- The intended commercial, advertising, training, and synthetic uses are allowed.
- Secret values and private source recordings are stored only in approved locations.

## Script Gate

- The final text matches the recorded script version.
- Speaker labels, language, pronunciation, numbers, names, and calls to action are correct.
- No passage is missing, duplicated, truncated, or fabricated.

## Listening Gate

- Voice identity is consistent.
- Delivery matches the brief.
- Pronunciation, emphasis, pauses, pacing, breaths, and emotion are acceptable.
- No clicks, pops, dropouts, digital distortion, excessive noise, or abrupt edits are audible.
- The beginning and tail are intact.

## Technical Gate

- File opens and contains a valid audio stream.
- Duration is plausible for the approved script.
- The production master is lossless and uses the required sample rate; video handoff defaults to 48 kHz PCM WAV when no receiver requirement conflicts.
- Channel count, bit depth, codec, loudness, peak, and file size meet the delivery brief.
- Scene timecodes fall within the master duration.
- Compressed delivery copies were derived from the approved master.

## Record Gate

- Provider, model, voice, settings, job IDs, script version, filenames, versions, cost, and approvals are recorded.
- The approved master is not overwritten.
- The manifest identifies current and superseded versions.
- Downstream consumers and stale assets are identified after a revision.

## Completion Gate

- A human or authorized approver accepted the voice and final performance when required.
- Listening review and technical inspection both passed.
- Required derivatives and manifest exist in the destination.
- The completion report separates verified results from unproven provider claims.
